title: Juicy Roasted Norwegian Beef Hash
description: A hearty Norwegian dish featuring roasted mixed beef cuts, pickle, and low-sodium ingredients, perfect for a filling meal. This recipe is designed to be low-sodium-friendly and energizing.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the beef cubes with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt-free seasoning blend, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the beef cubes in a single layer on a large baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the beef is roasting, toss the chopped onion, carrot, and potato with the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a separate bowl until they are evenly coated.
After the beef has roasted for 20 minutes, add the tossed vegetables to the baking sheet with the beef and continue to roast for an additional 20 minutes.
Remove the baking sheet from the oven and stir in the diced pickle.
Return the baking sheet to the oven and roast for an additional 10 minutes, or until the beef and vegetables are tender and lightly browned.
Remove the baking sheet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the juicy roasted Norwegian beef hash hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
Refrigerate and consume within 1 week — this preparation is not shelf-stable without an approved acid level and canning process.

Refrigerator pickle only: store in the fridge and consume within 1 week. For shelf-stable canning, add at least 2 tablespoons of vinegar (5% acidity) per cup of brine and follow a tested water-bath process.
